records.reason: First label for low-similarity biphenyl m210. This provides a donor-free aromatic baseline for graph distance and hydrophobic retention, filling a sparse neutral region with a relatively narrow predicted interval.

First label for phenyl beta-dicarbonyl m26 at 20/1. Its carbonyl topology bridges the measured aliphatic beta-ketoester m82 series, including 3ca8d2ff798fad4faffc and b6bf451b4911ee22d4a4, and the aroyl series m81.
First label for m69 at 1/1, giving a strong-eluent neutral ketone anchor. It helps calibrate the common short-retention region before extrapolation to weaker ratios.

First label for m54 at 10/1, adding a simple aromatic ketone at a condition where the model predicts a moderate completion interval. This tests substitution and ratio transfer in a heavily represented ketone family.
First label for m34 at 1/1 with PE loading. It supplies an early-ratio anchor for the fluoroacetophenone neighborhood and complements the measured weak-eluent m34 row 6998dee6f6e69401798a.
First label for m42 at 5/1 and PE loading. It tests whether the common acetophenone scaffold remains in the short-to-moderate branch at this ratio and loading condition.
m209 at 2/1 and 150 uL extends the measured m209 response from the lower-loading 2/1 point eda42a3c0f94ffce3e99 toward the later 10/1 and 20/1 points fe7d7af2c919facfe5f5 and 1b4be0410f927930d56e.

m191 at 2/1 and 50 uL fills the strong-eluent side of the dialdehyde curve before the measured 5/1 and 10/1 branches b8c35c514f5ef6c0f3bc and bae9d67e095423d8edd2. This tests when completion expansion begins.

m73 at 1/1 and 50 uL tests loading transfer around the unusual m73 behavior. The measured 1/1 and 2/1 points 2cf789c87f7c6325c020 and 49932dbd3d16bb64f71a, together with the non-reproducing repeat 45dca237351265a8f169, make this a useful local consistency check.

First label for m51 at 1/1 and PE loading. It probes transfer within the donor-containing aliphatic aromatic family while covering a condition and structure combination not directly anchored by the high-ratio donor rows.

First label for m35 at 5/1. The halogenated acetophenone adds a neutral substitution anchor at a moderate ratio and tests whether the model handles the heavier iodine environment without a generic late-volume shift.
First label for m15 at 20/1 and PE loading. This tests a simple aliphatic ester at weak eluent, supplying coverage for the short-to-moderate ester response region.

First label for methoxy-bromotoluene m111 at 50/1. It provides a high-ratio neutral aromatic anchor with substantial condition novelty and tests substitution transfer among short-retention halogenated anisoles.
m110 at 0/1 provides the strong-eluent endpoint for a trimethoxy aromatic. It is paired with the 2/1 experiment 0ae541927703401945de to measure a local ratio response at fixed loading.
First label for m80 at 5/1 with a small PE loading-solvent volume. This covers a multifunctional aliphatic ester at moderate ratio and tests whether the model's narrow predicted interval is reliable.
m12 at 20/1 and PE loading has a broad predicted onset spread. It probes a nonpolar fused-ring structure under weak eluent and can expose condition extrapolation errors in the neutral region.
m110 at 2/1 and 150 uL is a matched ratio-response experiment with ac52c50de335acae588d. The pair teaches whether the trimethoxy aromatic moves smoothly between strong and intermediate eluent.
First label for m115 at 10/1. The anisole ketone provides a substitution and carbonyl bridge between neutral anisoles and aromatic ketones, with a moderate predicted interval.
First label for m29 at 5/1 and low sample amount. It adds a crowded aromatic ketone at a condition where steric structure and loading may affect completion separately.
m22 at 0/1 and 150 uL supplies an early strong-eluent anchor for a benzyl acrylate-like ester. This helps calibrate the lower end of the ester condition response before weaker ratios.
m126 at 2/1 and PE loading provides an intermediate-ratio anisole anchor. It tests the common short-retention baseline and helps connect the many anisole substitution rows.

m190 at 2/1 and DCM loading tests a brominated salicylaldehyde topology at intermediate ratio. It bridges phenolic carbonyl observations and checks whether the model handles donor accessibility and halogen substitution jointly.
m25 at 0/1 and 150 uL supplies the strong-eluent endpoint for an aliphatic beta-ketoester. Together with the 50/1 m25 experiment 3fc05dc2025715e68174, it forms a broad ratio-response test.
m135 at 2/1 and 150 uL extends the measured donor response from the 1/1, 100 uL point 4d08b9494002d348513d and the later 5/1 and 10/1 points f9f0f4e29dbd30c000ee and 75232f4ee5de52a0499e.
m170 at 2/1 and 100 uL supplies an intermediate anchor for a chloro ketone. It tests whether the model transfers the short carbonyl response across loading and chain length.

m58 at 20/1 and 50 uL adds a low-amount weak-eluent point to the measured m58 sequence, including 04c495d5b53e3b1bceb7 and c023e9fab656fe2ce6a6. This tests the onset-completion coupling in a crowded phenol.

First label for m3 at 0/1 with a large loading-solvent volume. It probes a highly hydrophobic neutral scaffold at strong eluent and tests whether the loading-solvent representation captures its unusually broad predicted interval.

m197 at 2/1, PE loading, and 100 uL complements measured m197 points at 2/1 with 50 uL 8f1e0cc3c..., 10/1 a35c364f4fd2ced1ec2e, and 50/1 d7b688cd2da99329d657. It tests loading and ratio transfer in an ortho-hydroxyaldehyde.

m101 at 10/1 with a low loading-solvent volume adds a matched-volume aromatic ester anchor. The same molecule has multiple measured loading-volume and ratio records, making this useful for separating recorded volume effects from ratio response.
m149 at 0/1 and 150 uL provides a strong-eluent baseline for the mixed-halogen arene. It complements the measured 10/1 point 7ce4a1f0c500c875df7c and tests weak-to-strong condition transfer.

m25 at 50/1 and 100 uL completes the fixed-loading-solvent ratio curve begun by 9a207c449ef228ed648f. The pair tests whether the beta-ketoester remains short at strong eluent but develops a late completion tail at weak eluent.
m198 at 20/1 and 100 uL adds a nitrobenzaldehyde-like aromatic carbonyl at weak eluent. It tests transfer of long completion behavior across a polar but donor-free carbonyl structure.

feedback_interpretation: The latest feedback weakens transfer of the m125 loading-volume effect across ratios: the measured 2/1 pair 19f19f196ba5787a01b0 and facbcedbecb46072b04c differ greatly in completion, whereas the 5/1 pair 549daca56bed1c9d2bcc and 06ebbf6e52fa3ea6aef3 finishes at nearly the same volume. The close m92 repeat 95a3dcfe4436e929aa30 relative to 00a89de0e6cc7377a84b supports reproducibility of that exact tuple. The m212 measurements f1aa9023d49cdbe2d409, e0f2b47154fd134db700, 252c027cf5a42b92c953, and 942b8fc9cf013acda52b continue to indicate a sharp ratio response. Donor outcomes for m207 and m119 show that transition location is topology-specific, while the m73 repeat 45dca237351265a8f169 did not reproduce the narrow interval in 2cf789c87f7c6325c020.
batch_rationale: This batch combines broad coverage with scientifically useful local curves. Matched m110 and m25 conditions test ratio response directly, while m209, m191, m135, m58, and m197 extend measured structure-condition neighborhoods. Neutral, ester, ketone, halogenated-arene, donor, and carbonyl anchors cover different portions of the Row-distribution and include novel molecules and high-sensitivity predictions. The batch emphasizes interpolation and transfer around observed families, with a few first-label structures to repair sparse graph regions and improve generalization after retraining.
